payload.text: hv, 2026-10-17 evening: ST0008 AC-6.5's route is (a), the WSL job installs Intent's Linux musl binary from Intent's GitHub release (pinned tag v3.2.4) before the smoke list, and wsl-smoke.sh then asserts the critic gate passes on the intent/ fixture. CORRECTED the same evening: vc had said Intent's repository is private and needs a read-only token secret; it is PUBLIC (gh repo view: PUBLIC, and the v3.2.4 asset downloads anonymously, HTTP 200), so NO token and NO secret: the step downloads anonymously. Found while filling in GitHub's token form at hv's ask, before any token was generated; the form was abandoned unsubmitted. Not (b) Homebrew inside WSL, not (c) waiting.
